stemMd: Starting from 2, repeatedly square the current value. What is the value after three squaring operations?
explanationMd: The successive operations give 2²=4, 4²=16 and 16²=256. Count operations after the starting value. Repeated squaring grows more quickly than repeated doubling.

distractorRationale.b: This is the value after two squarings.
distractorRationale.c: This cubes four or otherwise changes the rule.
distractorRationale.a: This doubles repeatedly instead of squaring.
distractorRationale.e: This is the value after four squarings.
